stem:
Students poured water and cooking oil into a beaker. The students then added a penny, a plastic paper clip, and a cork to the beaker and recorded their observations.

Observations:

• The water was on the bottom, and the oil was on top of the water.

• The penny dropped to the bottom of the beaker.

• The plastic paper clip floated on the water but under the oil.

• The cork floated on top of the oil.

Which list puts the items in order from most dense to least dense?

options.label: A
options.text: Cork, oil, plastic paper clip, water, penny

options.label: B
options.text: Water, penny, oil, plastic paper clip, cork

options.label: C
options.text: Penny, water, plastic paper clip, oil, cork

options.label: D
options.text: Oil, penny, cork, plastic paper clip, water

visual_elements: Observations box with bullet points about the layers and objects: water on bottom, oil on top of water, penny bottom, plastic paper clip floats on water but under oil, cork floats on oil.
